name: Max Doors 25k Final Units Investor
description: Early TORIUM investor profile focused on maximizing the number of small sellable units created through fractioning.
notes: This profile is intentionally simple and assumption-based.
The provisional V2 planner uses bilocali of at least 40 saleable sqm and may preserve one residual monolocale of at least 28 saleable sqm.
The 28 sqm studio threshold is a conservative planning gate, not a substitute for technical and regulatory feasibility checks.
Transformation is provisionally estimated for every final unit in the completed project, not only for each additional unit created: EUR 25,000 for monolocali and bilocali, EUR 30,000 for trilocali.
Purchase-side costs are estimated separately through purchase_cost_rate and must be calibrated with real deals later.
